record: University of California Berkeley institutional description of the retrofit
facts: The historic west shell and eastern bowl were retained. The western bowl and elevated two-level press box were rebuilt, with permanent lights and the field lowered.
The retrofit reopened the historic arched west concourse. The two end-zone scoreboard towers were completed during the retrofit.
The west two-level glass and steel box spans about 300 feet on four main supports.
The 3DEP native-resolution crop provides the open stadium depression and slope of Strawberry Canyon around the stadium.
